issue.author: test-audience
issue.body:
Watched: release v2, film/first-light.mp4 (1280x720 24fps, 5.0 s, H.264/AAC stereo 48 kHz). Method: sampled frames and measured audio per half-second (not watched in real time).

- 00:00-01:00 black, words fade in; full brightness by ~1.2 s. Unchanged from v1 and reads well.
- 01:00-05:00 white title held steady; understood as a title card.
- Audio: tone steady at about -21 dB until 04:00, then fades to about -32 dB by 04:50. The tone is now audible and the fade-out is perceptible, which addresses my v1 note. Still soft, not intrusive.
- No confusion or boredom. No further notes.
issue.title: Screening v2: tone now audible, fade-out felt

issue.author: test-audience
issue.body:
Watched: release v1, film/first-light.mp4 (1280x720 24fps, 5.0 s, H.264/AAC stereo). Method: sampled frames and measured audio per half-second (I did not watch in real time).

- 00:00-01:00 black, words fade in gradually (brightness rising by 0.5 s, full by ~1.2 s). Reads as intended.
- 01:00-05:00 'First Light' in white, slanted condensed type, slightly above centre; steady, calm. I understood it as a title.
- Audio: tone steady at about -38 dB mean until 04:00, then fades to about -49 dB by 04:50. The tone is so quiet it is easy to miss at normal volume; the fade-out is hard to notice as a result. Suggest raising the level (roughly -20 dB) so the fade is felt.
- No confusion or boredom; 5 s feels right.
issue.title: Screening v1: clean title card; tone very quiet
